findings.summary: Command 'pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/result.spec.ts' could not run: the spec file does not exist yet. It is a capability-level check owned by integration/tester, not by this unit. It also needs the diagnosis backend (phase-1-backend-diagnoses) running. AC-dm-28 (ladder aria-label, layers order, italic lock phrase, 3 actions, guidance notice) and AC-dm-47 (reduced-motion path, bars filled at once, no horizontal scroll at 390px, axe) are verified by static reading only.
findings.failure_scenario: A later integration pass could find that the rendered result page diverges from the AC-dm-28 layer order or the AC-dm-47 reduced-motion behaviour, because no end-to-end run has observed the page.

findings.summary: Prototype motion is not implemented: the section entrance animation and the legend trace from the PRD AC-dm-47 list are absent. The implementer disclosed this; global.css is outside this unit. No approved deviation was found in the artifacts reviewed. Only the dimension bar fill animates.
findings.failure_scenario: Without reduced motion, the owner sees a static result page where the approved prototype would animate section entrance. Reduced-motion users are unaffected, so AC-dm-47 holds, but the prototype fidelity is reduced.

findings.summary: The dashed previous step is dropped when previousStage equals the current stage (trail is null at line 90). The caption still reads 'Antes: estágio N' from ResultPage.tsx:167, so the page shows a caption about a previous step that is not drawn. AC-dm-28 asks for the dashed previous step.
findings.failure_scenario: A company whose previous and current diagnoses are both stage 2 sees 'Antes: estágio 2' in the caption and no dashed step on the ladder. The AC wording does not say what should happen in this case, so this is a judgement call to confirm.

findings.summary: Two sections titled 'Seus números' appear on the same page: the NumbersAside at lines 120-135 (CAC and ratio) and NumbersSummary (CAC, LTV, ratio, payback). The same CAC and ratio values are shown twice under identical headings.
findings.failure_scenario: Screen-reader users hear two 'Seus números' headings and the owner sees the same CAC and ratio twice, which may read as a duplicated or inconsistent block.

messages.text: Before the e2e run: (1) confirm phase-1-backend-diagnoses has passed; (2) the tester/integration creates tests/e2e/result.spec.ts (it does not exist yet); (3) run 'pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/result.spec.ts' against the running app. Cover the ladder aria-label, the risk list and no-risk state, confidence and provisional note, a scan of the rendered text, emulateMedia reducedMotion with bars filled at once, 390px with no horizontal scroll, axe, and time to result.

Implementer question resolved: diagnosisService.ts findPrevious returns the older completed diagnosis of the company and excludes the record itself. So previous.stage is the stage before this one, as ResultPage.tsx assumes. The 'Antes: estágio N' caption is therefore correct.
Deferred to other capabilities, not part of this unit: the 'Exportar PDF' action belongs to CAP-dm-report and 'Comparar com ...' belongs to CAP-dm-compare. Neither is rendered on the result page yet.
